messages.subject: source() in ui.r again!!
parts:
Dear, good night!

Although it has a topic "source () in ui.r", the proposed solution did not solve my problem. Everytime I try to upload a file (widgets_full.r for example) via "source()" in the file "ui.r" and an error is generated which a priori should not exist. Why? When I copy and paste exactly what is in the file "widgets_full.r" within the file "ui.r", the application works perfectly. Therefore, the error is a mystery! If anyone can help me would be extremely grateful. Follow the attached files!

Sincerely,

messages.subject: Re: source() in ui.r again!!
parts:
Also your entire widgets_full.R needs to be wrapped in a call to tagList. The idea is that the sourced file will return a single expression. In this case, a tagList containing all the other components.
